sections.heading: Definitions
sections.text: In this ordinance, "permit holder" means a person named on a park event permit issued by the Parks Director of the City of Ashgrove.

sections.heading: Applications
sections.text:
(a) An applicant shall submit a park event application not later than March 15, 2027.
(b) The Parks Director shall decide each application within twenty-one (21) calendar days after the application is received.

sections.heading: Event conduct
sections.text:
(a) A permit holder shall post the permit at the event entrance and shall keep a copy at the first aid tent.
(b) A permit holder shall remove all litter from the park within two (2) calendar days after the event ends.
(c) A permit holder may not use amplified sound inside a nature reserve.

sections.heading: Fees
sections.text:
(a) A permit holder shall pay the event fee before the event begins.
(b) A permit holder is not required to pay a fee for an event with fewer than twenty guests.

sections.heading: Closing
sections.text: (a) The Parks Director shall lock the park gates at closing time.

sections.heading: Short title
sections.text: This ordinance may be cited as the Ashgrove Park Event Permit Ordinance.

amendments.instructionText: In Sec. 3(c), after "inside a nature reserve" insert "or a playground".

operations.new: inside a nature reserve or a playground

amendments.instructionText: In Sec. 3(a), strike "at the event entrance" and insert "at the main event entrance". In Sec. 5(a), strike "at closing time" and insert "at the posted closing time".
